hook: Sony Music allegedly owes $1.25 million in unpaid royalties to a producer.

sections.voiceover: Sony Music allegedly owes $1.25 million in unpaid royalties to a producer.
Oct 16, 2026, Ishmael Sadiq Montague sued Sony Music in New York federal court over “Party”. If Sony paid $0.625 million, how much remains owed?
But the filing alleges Sony still owes the full $1.25 million.

Montague’s lawsuit demands the unpaid $1.25 million royalty. He argues Sony only delivered $0.625 million, half the agreed 1.5 % share. If the court upholds the contract, Sony must pay the full $1.25 million.
Sony faces a $1.25 million liability if sued.
